items.definition: A shipment's lifecycle runs: booking, pickup or cargo receipt at origin, export clearance, departure, transit (and any transshipment), arrival at destination, import clearance, release, delivery and proof of delivery.
items.definition_ar: دورة حياة الشحنة: الحجز، ثم الاستلام في المنشأ، وتخليص التصدير، والمغادرة، والعبور (وأي مسافنة)، والوصول للوجهة، وتخليص الاستيراد، والإفراج، والتسليم، وإثبات التسليم.
items.explanation: Each step has an owner and a document or event that proves it. Tracking is the record of which of these the evidence shows have happened — not what the plan says should have happened.

sources.note: DCSA's track-and-trace event model covers the ocean part; this summary is ATLAS's own.

items.definition: A booking reserves space and equipment with a carrier for a planned sailing or flight; the carrier's confirmation gives a booking number, the vessel or flight and the cut-offs.
items.definition_ar: الحجز يضمن مساحة ومعدات لدى الناقل لرحلة مخططة، ويعطي تأكيد الناقل رقم حجز والسفينة أو الرحلة والمواعيد النهائية.
items.explanation: A booking is a plan, not a movement: cargo can still be rolled. Before the B/L or AWB exists, the booking number is often the only reference the carrier knows.

items.definition: Pickup is the collection of the goods from the shipper (or their receipt at the carrier's terminal — 'gate in' for a container, 'received from shipper' for air cargo).
items.definition_ar: الاستلام هو أخذ البضاعة من الشاحن أو استلامها في محطة الناقل (Gate in للحاويات، أو Received from shipper للشحن الجوي).

items.definition: Departure is the means of transport leaving origin with the goods on board, proven by a departure event (vessel departure, flight departed, loaded on board).
items.definition_ar: المغادرة هي خروج وسيلة النقل من المنشأ والبضاعة على متنها، ويثبتها حدث مغادرة (مغادرة السفينة أو الرحلة أو التحميل على المتن).
items.explanation: 'Manifested' or 'booked on' a flight is not departure: cargo can be offloaded at the last minute.

items.definition: Arrival is the means of transport reaching the destination port or airport with the goods. Arrival at a transit point is not arrival at destination.
items.definition_ar: الوصول هو بلوغ وسيلة النقل ميناء أو مطار الوجهة والبضاعة عليها، والوصول إلى نقطة عبور ليس وصولًا للوجهة.
items.explanation: For a container, vessel arrival, discharge and availability for pickup can be days apart. Which event a company calls 'arrival' is a business definition; in this platform the ATA is the arrival at the destination, never at a transit point.

items.definition: The delivery milestone is the goods being handed to the consignee at the final place; it comes after arrival and, for imports, after customs release.
items.definition_ar: مرحلة التسليم هي تسليم البضاعة للمرسل إليه في المكان النهائي، وتأتي بعد الوصول وبعد الإفراج الجمركي في حالة الواردات.
items.explanation: A delivery date is never an arrival date: in this platform's DHL rules a delivery is never taken as the ATA.

items.definition: A proof of delivery is the record that the goods were delivered: who received them, when, where and in what condition — a signed delivery note or an electronic POD.
items.definition_ar: إثبات التسليم سجل يثبت تسليم البضاعة: من استلمها ومتى وأين وبأي حالة، مثل إذن تسليم موقع أو إثبات إلكتروني.
items.explanation: Remarks on the POD (damaged, short) are the basis for claims; a clean POD signed without checking weakens a later claim.

items.definition: ETA is the Estimated Time of Arrival — the carrier's current forecast, which can change. ATA is the Actual Time of Arrival — when the vessel or flight really arrived, recorded after the fact.
items.definition_ar: الـ ETA هو موعد الوصول المتوقع، وهو توقع الناقل الحالي وقد يتغير. الـ ATA هو موعد الوصول الفعلي، أي متى وصلت السفينة أو الرحلة فعلًا، ويُسجل بعد حدوثه.
items.explanation: In this Control Tower the run reads both from the carrier and writes the ETA (and the ATA when there is one) to the Hub. An ETA in the past with no ATA is a data-freshness question, not proof of arrival.

items.definition: ETD is the Estimated Time of Departure from the origin port or airport; ATD is the Actual Time of Departure, recorded once it has left.
items.definition_ar: الـ ETD موعد المغادرة المتوقع من ميناء أو مطار المنشأ، والـ ATD موعد المغادرة الفعلي ويُسجل بعد المغادرة.

items.definition: A milestone is a significant event in a shipment's journey, recorded with a code or description, a time (actual or estimated), a place and a source.
items.definition_ar: المرحلة (Milestone) حدث مهم في رحلة الشحنة يُسجل برمز أو وصف ووقت (فعلي أو متوقع) ومكان ومصدر.
items.explanation: Always keep apart estimated events (a forecast) from actual ones (something happened), and the place of the event from the shipment's destination. Carriers do not share one vocabulary: DCSA standardises ocean events, but airlines and integrators like DHL use their own wording, so each carrier needs its own verified mapping.
misconceptions: The same word ('Arrived', 'Delivered') does not mean the same event at every carrier.

items.definition: Status transitions are the allowed order of a shipment's states (booked → departed → arrived → cleared → delivered); an event that breaks the order is out of sequence and needs checking.
items.definition_ar: انتقالات الحالة هي الترتيب المسموح لحالات الشحنة (محجوزة ← غادرت ← وصلت ← خُلصت ← سُلمت)، والحدث الذي يكسر الترتيب غير متسلسل ويحتاج تدقيقًا.
items.explanation: Out-of-sequence data has ordinary causes — time zones, a split shipment, a late-entered event, a carrier correction — and occasionally a real error. This platform refuses to write an ATA that comes after a later step such as delivery; it sends the shipment to a person.

items.definition: An exception is any deviation from the shipment's plan or normal flow that needs attention: a delay, missed connection, customs hold, damage, short delivery, missing update or conflicting data.
items.definition_ar: الاستثناء أي انحراف عن خطة الشحنة أو مسارها الطبيعي يستدعي الانتباه: تأخير، فوات رحلة، حجز جمركي، تلف، نقص في التسليم، توقف التحديثات، أو تعارض البيانات.
items.explanation: Exception management is: detect early, classify, find the owner, act, verify the result and record what worked. Detecting needs a baseline (the plan or SLA) to compare against.

items.definition: A delay is a milestone happening — or forecast to happen — later than the plan, promise or SLA it is measured against.
items.definition_ar: التأخير حدوث مرحلة (أو توقع حدوثها) بعد موعد الخطة أو الوعد أو اتفاقية الخدمة التي تُقاس عليها.
items.explanation: 'Late' needs a reference: late against the booked schedule, the customer promise, or yesterday's ETA are three different questions. A cause needs evidence; without it, list possible causes as hypotheses.

items.definition: A missing update is a shipment whose carrier has reported no new event for longer than expected for its stage.
items.definition_ar: انقطاع التحديثات هو عدم إبلاغ الناقل عن أي حدث جديد للشحنة لمدة أطول من المتوقع لمرحلتها.
items.explanation: Silence is not evidence that nothing happened, nor that something went wrong: long ocean legs are naturally quiet, while a parcel quiet for days is a warning. Compare against the stage's normal gap, then ask the carrier.

items.definition: A failed handoff is the goods or their information not passing correctly between parties or legs: a missed connection, cargo offloaded from a flight, documents not reaching the broker, a container not released to the trucker.
items.definition_ar: فشل التسليم هو عدم انتقال البضاعة أو معلوماتها بشكل صحيح بين الأطراف أو المراحل: فوات رحلة ربط، أو إنزال البضاعة من الطائرة، أو عدم وصول المستندات للمخلص، أو عدم الإفراج عن الحاوية للناقل البري.

items.definition: Reconciliation compares the same shipment across systems — carrier, forwarder, customs, ERP, the Hub — and resolves differences in references, quantities, dates and statuses.
items.definition_ar: المطابقة مقارنة نفس الشحنة بين الأنظمة (الناقل، الوكيل، الجمارك، نظام ERP، الـ Hub) وحل الاختلافات في المراجع والكميات والتواريخ والحالات.
items.explanation: Decide in advance which system is the authority for which field (the carrier for movement events, customs for release, the ERP for the order). This platform writes carrier dates to the Hub only after its own checks, then reads the Hub back to prove the write.

items.definition: Data freshness is how recently a piece of data was confirmed at its source. Every status shown should carry when it was read and from where.
items.definition_ar: حداثة البيانات هي مدى قرب آخر تأكيد للمعلومة من مصدرها، ويجب أن تحمل كل حالة معروضة وقت قراءتها ومصدرها.
items.explanation: An answer built on yesterday's export or last week's carrier read must say so. ATLAS states the export's 'as of' date for clearance figures and the run time for carrier data, and never presents an old reading as live.

items.definition: Conflicting statuses are two sources (or two events from one source) that cannot both be true: two different actual arrival dates, 'delivered' before 'arrived', or the Hub holding a different ATA from the carrier.
items.definition_ar: تعارض الحالات وجود مصدرين (أو حدثين من نفس المصدر) لا يمكن أن يكونا صحيحين معًا: تاريخا وصول فعلي مختلفان، أو تسليم قبل الوصول، أو اختلاف الـ ATA في الـ Hub عن الناقل.
items.explanation: Do not pick the convenient one. Check for legitimate explanations (split pieces, a transit-point arrival, time zones, a correction), and if none settles it, escalate to a person with both values and their sources. This platform does exactly that: conflicting actual arrivals are not chosen between, nothing is written, and the shipment goes to review.

items.definition: Escalation is raising an exception to someone with more authority or capacity to resolve it, when it passes a threshold (time, value, customer impact) or the first owner cannot fix it.
items.definition_ar: التصعيد رفع الاستثناء إلى من لديه صلاحية أو قدرة أكبر لحله عندما يتجاوز حدًا (زمنيًا أو ماليًا أو تأثيرًا على العميل) أو يعجز المسؤول الأول عن حله.
items.explanation: A good escalation states the facts, the evidence, what was already tried, the impact and the decision needed. In the Clearance page, escalating a past-due step records who escalated, when and why, and it shows on the To Do list until resolved.

items.definition: Human in the loop means an automated process stops at defined points for a person to decide, approve or complete a step, instead of acting on uncertain evidence.
items.definition_ar: تدخل الإنسان يعني أن العملية الآلية تتوقف عند نقاط محددة ليقرر شخص أو يوافق أو يكمل خطوة، بدل التصرف على أدلة غير مؤكدة.
items.explanation: In this platform people decide when the carrier's dates are ambiguous (Needs review), when a carrier site asks for a security check (Human action — never solved by the automation), and before a PO email is sent when auto-send is off.

items.definition: This platform maps each DHL event to one type from DHL's own wording, per product: for DHL Global Forwarding, 'Carrier: Arrived' (or 'Arrived Final Destination' at an airport or port) is the actual arrival, 'Carrier: Arrived (… Transit Point)' is a transit stop, 'Estimated Carrier Arrival (Destination)' is the ETA, and 'Estimated Delivery' is never the ETA. For DHL Express, 'Arrived at DHL Sort/Delivery Facility <place> - <COUNTRY>' is the arrival only when the country is the shipment's destination.
items.definition_ar: تطابق هذه المنصة كل حدث من DHL مع نوع واحد حسب صياغة DHL ولكل منتج: في DHL Global Forwarding يعتبر 'Carrier: Arrived' (أو 'Arrived Final Destination' في مطار أو ميناء) وصولًا فعليًا، و'Carrier: Arrived (… Transit Point)' توقف عبور، و'Estimated Carrier Arrival (Destination)' هو الـ ETA، و'Estimated Delivery' لا يُعتبر ETA أبدًا. وفي DHL Express يعتبر 'Arrived at DHL Sort/Delivery Facility <مكان> - <الدولة>' وصولًا فقط إذا كانت الدولة هي وجهة الشحنة.
items.explanation: The mapping was built from DHL pages the automation saved in October 2026, not from documentation alone. 'Arrived Final Destination' at a city (not an airport) is DHL's station after import clearance and is never taken as the ATA. Other DHL products and modes are not mapped: their events go to review.
limitations: Verified on DHL Global Forwarding and DHL Express pages only. Other carriers have their own readers in update_eta.py.

items.term: Air cargo station status codes (DHL Aviation)
items.definition: Air cargo checkpoints are reported per station with short codes: RCS (received from shipper), DEP (departed), ARR (arrived), RCF (received from flight), NFD (notified for delivery / awaiting collection), AWD (documents delivered), DLV (delivered); FFM is the flight manifest — planned, not a movement.
items.definition_ar: تُسجل نقاط الشحن الجوي لكل محطة برموز قصيرة: RCS (استلام من الشاحن)، DEP (مغادرة)، ARR (وصول)، RCF (استلام من الرحلة)، NFD (إخطار بالاستلام/بانتظار المستلم)، AWD (تسليم المستندات)، DLV (تسليم)؛ وFFM هو مانيفست الرحلة أي تخطيط لا حركة.
items.explanation: On DHL Aviation pages this platform takes the ATA as the day the last of the shipment's pieces reached the destination station by an arrival checkpoint (RCF, ARR, NFD, AWD, DLV); a shipment only partly there has no ATA yet.
